title: Characterization of AND output inputs
statement: Let $r$ be a natural number, and index a layer of size $2^r$ by sign assignments to $r$ positions. An index $i$ belongs to the input set of the parity circuit's AND output if and only if the product of the signs in the assignment corresponding to $i$ is $-1$.
hypotheses_covered: $i$ is an index in the layer of size $2^r$
